title: Bias in the Ear of the Listener: Assessing Sensitivity in Audio Language Models Across Linguistic, Demographic, and Positional Variations
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the robustness of multilingual multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to speech-specific perturbations (accent, gender, volume, speed) and structural variations (option order). While the benchmark (BIASINEAR, derived from Global MMLU Lite) includes 'culturally sensitive' questions that may touch on religious or cultural practices (such as cremation), the study's focus is on measuring uncertainty and consistency across acoustic and positional changes rather than explicitly benchmarking the model's stance on or knowledge of religion, morals, or ethics.
